# jsQR 1.4.0

Vendored from the exact npm jsqr@1.4.0 tarball, verified against npm dist.integrity (SHA-512). Source: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR ; Apache-2.0 license in jsqr-LICENSE.txt. Used locally for QR decoding when BarcodeDetector is unavailable. No CDN, camera-frame upload or runtime network dependency.
